properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 9 at 5:13PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 511 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from 6 miles south of Springfield to 15 miles north
of Kenton to near Kim. Movement was southeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 60 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Campo and open country of southeastern Las Animas and southwestern
Baca counties.
properties.areaDesc: Eastern Las Animas County; Springfield Vicinity/Baca County

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 9 at 4:53PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 453 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of showers and
thunderstorms extending from near Purcell to near Platteville, or
extending from 19 miles northeast of Greeley to 18 miles south of
Greeley, moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Southeastern Greeley, Evans, LaSalle, Kersey, Gill, Barnesville,
Galeton, Milton Reservoir, Briggsdale, Garden City, Hardin, Cornish
and Lower Latham Reservoir.
